theme: 3 terms for a SwiftUI login form: hidden typing, the return key text and the keyboard focus

terms.definition: A text field that hides what the user types, for example a password.
terms.example: Use a SecureField for the password.

terms.definition: A modifier that sets the text of the keyboard return key, such as Go or Next.
terms.example: Set the Submit Label to Next, so users move on faster.

terms.definition: A property wrapper that tracks which field has the keyboard focus, and lets you change it.
terms.example: Use FocusState to open the keyboard on the first field.

video.title: SecureField, Submit Label & FocusState | Day 161
video.description:
Learn to explain how to build a login form in SwiftUI: SecureField, Submit Label & FocusState, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
SecureField - A text field that hides what the user types, for example a password.
Submit Label - A modifier that sets the text of the keyboard return key, such as Go or Next.
FocusState - A property wrapper that tracks which field has the keyboard focus, and lets you change it.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI SecureField, Submit Label & FocusState | Day 161
landscape.description:
Explain SecureField, Submit Label & FocusState in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
시큐어필드, 서브밋 레이블, 포커스스테이트 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

SecureField - A text field that hides what the user types, for example a password.
한국어: 시큐어필드: 비밀번호처럼 사용자가 입력하는 내용을 숨겨 주는 텍스트 필드

Submit Label - A modifier that sets the text of the keyboard return key, such as Go or Next.
한국어: 서브밋 레이블: 키보드의 리턴 키에 표시되는 글자(Go, Next 등)를 정하는 수정자

FocusState - A property wrapper that tracks which field has the keyboard focus, and lets you change it.
한국어: 포커스스테이트: 어느 필드에 키보드 포커스가 있는지 추적하고, 바꿀 수도 있게 해 주는 프로퍼티 래퍼

landscape.hook: Can you explain SecureField, Submit Label and FocusState in English?

dialogue.title: The password is visible

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my login screen shows the password in plain text.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a SecureField. It hides what the user types.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I changed it to a SecureField, and now I see only dots.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Now look at the keyboard. Which Submit Label does it use?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The default, it says return. I want it to say Go.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then change the Submit Label. It chooses the text of the return key, like Go or Next.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I wrote `.submitLabel(.go)`. Can I jump to the next field by myself?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, with a FocusState. It tracks which field has the keyboard focus.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how do I change the focus?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You set the FocusState value, like `f`, and the keyboard moves to that field.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if I never set the FocusState?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the user taps the field by hand. That is not nice for a login screen.
Use a SecureField for the password.
